h.en: 3.1(a) Purpose of cracking — why large molecules are broken
h.gu: 3.1(a) Cracking નો હેતુ — મોટા molecules કેમ તોડવા પડે છે

body.en:
Definition / principle

Cracking is the chemical breaking of large, heavy hydrocarbon molecules into smaller molecules in the petrol, LPG and diesel ranges, by heat alone or by heat with a catalyst.

Detailed theory and conditions

Crude distillation gives whatever petrol-range material the crude happens to contain (Unit 1: a topping refinery cannot create more), while the market demands far more petrol and LPG than most crudes contain and far less heavy fuel oil. Cracking closes that gap in both directions: it converts surplus vacuum gas oil and residue into petrol-range hydrocarbons, light olefin gases (propylene, butylenes — also petrochemical and alkylation feed) and LPG, at the cost of some gas and coke. In reaction terms, a long paraffin chain breaks into a shorter paraffin plus an olefin — for example a C16 molecule giving petrol-range C8 material — with further breaking, rearrangement (isomerisation) and hydrogen-transfer reactions deciding the exact product quality.

Key points and data

  • Feed: vacuum gas oil, atmospheric/vacuum residue, or deasphalted oil, according to process.
  • Wanted products: petrol-range hydrocarbons, LPG and light olefins, lighter diesel.
  • Unavoidable by-products: dry gas and coke — the deeper the cracking (conversion), the more of both.

Qualification

Cracking cannot turn the whole barrel into petrol: every increment of conversion makes disproportionately more gas and coke, so each process runs at an economic severity, not the maximum chemically possible.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Cracking એ મોટા, ભારે hydrocarbon molecules ને ફક્ત heat થી કે heat સાથે catalyst થી petrol, LPG તથા diesel ranges ના નાના molecules માં તોડવાની chemical પ્રક્રિયા છે.

વિગતવાર Theory તથા Conditions

Crude distillation crude માં જે petrol-range material હોય તે જ આપે છે (Unit 1: topping refinery વધુ બનાવી શકતી નથી), જ્યારે market મોટાભાગના crudes માં હોય તેના કરતાં ઘણું વધુ petrol તથા LPG માંગે છે અને ઘણું ઓછું heavy fuel oil. Cracking આ gap બંને દિશામાં પૂરો કરે છે: તે વધારાના vacuum gas oil તથા residue ને petrol-range hydrocarbons, light olefin gases (propylene, butylenes — petrochemical તથા alkylation feed પણ) તથા LPG માં ફેરવે છે, થોડા gas તથા coke ના ખર્ચે. Reaction ની ભાષામાં, લાંબી paraffin chain ટૂંકા paraffin વત્તા olefin માં તૂટે છે — દાખલા તરીકે C16 molecule petrol-range C8 material આપે છે — વધુ breaking, rearrangement (isomerisation) તથા hydrogen-transfer reactions ચોક્કસ product quality નક્કી કરે છે.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Feed: process મુજબ vacuum gas oil, atmospheric/vacuum residue, કે deasphalted oil.
  • ઇચ્છિત products: petrol-range hydrocarbons, LPG તથા light olefins, હલકું diesel.
  • અનિવાર્ય by-products: dry gas તથા coke — cracking જેટલું ઊંડું (conversion), તેટલા બંને વધુ.

મર્યાદા / Qualification

Cracking આખા barrel ને petrol માં ફેરવી શકતું નથી: conversion નો દરેક વધારો અપ્રમાણસર વધુ gas તથા coke બનાવે છે, તેથી દરેક process economic severity પર ચાલે છે, રાસાયણિક રીતે શક્ય મહત્તમ પર નહીં.

h.en: 3.1(b) Effect of temperature and pressure on cracking
h.gu: 3.1(b) Cracking પર temperature તથા pressure ની અસર

body.en:
Definition / principle

Temperature decides how fast and how far cracking goes; pressure decides which kind of products are favoured, because cracking increases the number of molecules and therefore the gas volume.

Detailed theory and conditions

Raising temperature speeds every bond-breaking reaction sharply (reaction rate roughly doubles for each 10 °C rise, as a working rule), so higher temperature at a fixed residence time gives higher conversion — but it also favours breaking the small products further, into dry gas, and favours coke formation. Cracking is therefore always a compromise between temperature and residence (contact) time: short contact at high temperature (FCC) and longer soaking at lower temperature (delayed coking) can reach similar conversion with different product patterns. Pressure acts the other way thermodynamically: because one large molecule becomes several small ones, high pressure opposes cracking itself but promotes the secondary reactions — hydrogen transfer, condensation and polymerisation — that saturate olefins, raise liquid yield and density, and lay down coke; low pressure (and steam dilution) favours olefinic, lighter products and less coke. Catalysts, where used, change the path itself (card 3.1(e)), giving more branched, higher-octane petrol at much lower pressure than thermal cracking.

Key points and data

  • Temperature ↑: conversion ↑, but gas and coke ↑ faster beyond the optimum severity.
  • Residence time ↑: acts like higher temperature; temperature × time together set severity.
  • Pressure ↑: suppresses volume-increasing cracking, promotes condensation/coke and more saturated liquids.
  • Steam/inert dilution: lowers hydrocarbon partial pressure, favouring lighter olefinic products.

Qualification

There is no free direction: the same severity that maximises petrol volume degrades its stability and increases coke, so operating conditions are chosen for the product slate and catalyst/equipment limits, not for conversion alone.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Temperature નક્કી કરે છે cracking કેટલું ઝડપી અને કેટલું દૂર જાય છે; pressure નક્કી કરે છે કયા પ્રકારના products ને પ્રાધાન્ય મળે છે, કારણ કે cracking molecules ની સંખ્યા અને તેથી gas volume વધારે છે.

વિગતવાર Theory તથા Conditions

Temperature વધારવાથી દરેક bond-breaking reaction ની ઝડપ તીવ્ર વધે છે (working rule તરીકે દરેક 10 °C વધારે rate આશરે બમણો), તેથી નિશ્ચિત residence time પર વધુ temperature વધુ conversion આપે છે — પણ તે નાના products ને વધુ તોડી dry gas બનાવવાને અને coke formation ને પણ પ્રાધાન્ય આપે છે. તેથી cracking હંમેશા temperature તથા residence (contact) time વચ્ચે સમાધાન છે: ઊંચા temperature પર ટૂંકો contact (FCC) અને નીચા temperature પર લાંબું soaking (delayed coking) જુદા product patterns સાથે સમાન conversion સુધી પહોંચી શકે છે. Pressure thermodynamic રીતે વિરુદ્ધ કામ કરે છે: એક મોટું molecule અનેક નાના બનતું હોવાથી, ઊંચું pressure cracking ને જ રોકે છે પણ secondary reactions — hydrogen transfer, condensation તથા polymerisation — ને પ્રોત્સાહન આપે છે, જે olefins ને saturate કરે છે, liquid yield તથા density વધારે છે અને coke જમા કરે છે; નીચું pressure (તથા steam dilution) olefinic, હલકા products તથા ઓછા coke ને પ્રાધાન્ય આપે છે. Catalyst, જ્યાં વપરાય છે, path જ બદલી નાખે છે (card 3.1(e)), thermal cracking કરતાં ઘણા ઓછા pressure પર વધુ branched, higher-octane petrol આપે છે.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Temperature ↑: conversion ↑, પણ optimum severity થી આગળ gas તથા coke વધુ ઝડપથી ↑.
  • Residence time ↑: વધુ temperature ની જેમ કામ કરે છે; temperature × time સાથે મળી severity નક્કી કરે છે.
  • Pressure ↑: volume-વધારતા cracking ને દબાવે છે, condensation/coke તથા વધુ saturated liquids ને પ્રોત્સાહન આપે છે.
  • Steam/inert dilution: hydrocarbon partial pressure ઘટાડે છે, હલકા olefinic products ને પ્રાધાન્ય આપે છે.

મર્યાદા / Qualification

કોઈ મફત દિશા નથી: petrol volume મહત્તમ કરતી એ જ severity તેની stability બગાડે છે અને coke વધારે છે, તેથી operating conditions product slate તથા catalyst/equipment limits માટે પસંદ થાય છે, ફક્ત conversion માટે નહીં.

h.en: 3.1(c)(i) Thermal cracking — visbreaking: construction and working
h.gu: 3.1(c)(i) Thermal cracking — visbreaking: construction તથા working

body.en:
Definition / principle

Visbreaking (viscosity breaking) is mild thermal cracking of vacuum/atmospheric residue, just severe enough to break the molecules that make residue viscous, so that less cutter oil is needed to sell it as fuel oil.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Heater (furnace): residue is heated in tubes to cracking temperature (of the order of 450–500 °C, process-dependent).
  2. Soaker drum (in soaker visbreaking): an insulated vessel giving residence time at temperature, so the furnace itself runs cooler and cokes less.
  3. Flash/fractionator column: cracked products are separated into gas, naphtha, gas oil and visbroken residue (tar).

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Residue is heated; long chains attaching the heavy molecules break preferentially, so viscosity falls sharply for only a small conversion to gas and naphtha.
  2. The effluent is quenched and fractionated; stable visbroken residue is blended to fuel-oil viscosity with much less valuable cutter stock than untreated residue would need.

Limitations and safety

Visbreaking is deliberately stopped early: push severity further and the residue becomes unstable (asphaltenes precipitate, sediment forms in stored fuel). It improves fuel-oil yield, it does not make large amounts of petrol.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Visbreaking (viscosity breaking) એ vacuum/atmospheric residue નું હળવું thermal cracking છે, એટલું જ severe કે residue ને viscous બનાવતા molecules તૂટે, જેથી તેને fuel oil તરીકે વેચવા ઓછું cutter oil જોઈએ.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Heater (furnace): residue tubes માં cracking temperature (આશરે 450–500 °C ક્રમનું, process-આધારિત) સુધી ગરમ થાય છે.
  2. Soaker drum (soaker visbreaking માં): temperature પર residence time આપતું insulated vessel, જેથી furnace પોતે ઠંડું ચાલે અને ઓછું coke થાય.
  3. Flash/fractionator column: cracked products gas, naphtha, gas oil તથા visbroken residue (tar) માં છૂટા પડે છે.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Residue ગરમ થાય છે; ભારે molecules ને જોડતી લાંબી chains પ્રાધાન્યથી તૂટે છે, તેથી gas તથા naphtha માં નાના conversion માટે જ viscosity તીવ્ર ઘટે છે.
  2. Effluent quench તથા fractionate થાય છે; stable visbroken residue અનુપચારિત residue ને જોઈતા કરતાં ઘણા ઓછા મૂલ્યવાન cutter stock સાથે fuel-oil viscosity પર blend થાય છે.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

Visbreaking જાણીજોઈને વહેલું અટકાવાય છે: severity વધુ ધકેલો તો residue unstable બને છે (asphaltenes precipitate થાય, stored fuel માં sediment બને). તે fuel-oil yield સુધારે છે, મોટા પ્રમાણમાં petrol બનાવતું નથી.

h.en: 3.1(c)(i) Delayed coking and fluid coking — turning residue into coke and lighter products
h.gu: 3.1(c)(i) Delayed coking તથા fluid coking — residue ને coke તથા હલકા products માં ફેરવવા

body.en:
Definition / principle

Coking is severe thermal cracking in which the heaviest part of the residue is rejected as solid petroleum coke, so that almost all the liquid becomes lighter, saleable products. Delayed coking does this in large drums, one filling while the other is emptied; fluid coking does it continuously on a circulating bed of hot coke particles.

Construction — part and purpose (delayed coking)

  1. Heater: residue is heated rapidly to about 480–510 °C (typical range) and sent onward before it can coke the tubes.
  2. Coke drums (pair): cracking and coke deposition are delayed until the feed reaches the drum, where it soaks, cracks and leaves solid coke; vapours leave the top to the fractionator.
  3. Fractionator: separates gas, naphtha, light and heavy coker gas oils (heavy gas oil is recycled or sent to hydrocracking/FCC).
  4. Coke cutting: after cooling, coke is cut from the drum with high-pressure water jets and handled as a solid product (fuel or, from suitable feeds, anode-grade coke).

Working — fluid coking, and the common idea

In fluid coking the residue is sprayed onto hot circulating coke particles in a reactor; cracked vapours leave, coke grows on the particles, and part of the coke is burned in a burner vessel to supply heat (in flexicoking the coke is gasified further). In both processes the principle is the same: reject carbon as coke so that the liquid balance of the barrel becomes light products instead of fuel oil.

Limitations and safety

Coking units are high-temperature, batch-sequenced (drum switching, steam-out, water cutting) operations run only under strict refinery procedures. Coke quality decides its market: high-sulfur, high-metal coke from sour residue is only fuel grade.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Coking એ severe thermal cracking છે જેમાં residue નો સૌથી ભારે ભાગ ઘન petroleum coke તરીકે નકારાય છે, જેથી લગભગ બધું liquid હલકા, વેચી શકાય તેવા products બને છે. Delayed coking આ મોટા drums માં કરે છે, એક ભરાય ત્યારે બીજું ખાલી થાય છે; fluid coking આ સતત hot coke particles ના circulating bed પર કરે છે.

Construction — part and purpose (delayed coking)

  1. Heater: residue ઝડપથી આશરે 480–510 °C (typical range) સુધી ગરમ થઈ tubes ને coke કરે તે પહેલાં આગળ મોકલાય છે.
  2. Coke drums (જોડી): cracking તથા coke deposition feed drum માં પહોંચે ત્યાં સુધી delayed રહે છે, જ્યાં તે soak થાય છે, crack થાય છે અને ઘન coke છોડે છે; vapours ઉપરથી fractionator તરફ જાય છે.
  3. Fractionator: gas, naphtha, light તથા heavy coker gas oils છૂટા પાડે છે (heavy gas oil recycle થાય છે કે hydrocracking/FCC તરફ જાય છે).
  4. Coke cutting: ઠંડું પાડ્યા પછી, coke drum માંથી high-pressure water jets થી કપાય છે અને ઘન product તરીકે handle થાય છે (fuel કે, યોગ્ય feeds માંથી, anode-grade coke).

Working — fluid coking, અને સામાન્ય વિચાર

Fluid coking માં residue reactor માં hot circulating coke particles પર spray થાય છે; cracked vapours નીકળી જાય છે, coke particles પર વધે છે, અને coke નો ભાગ burner vessel માં બાળી heat પૂરી પાડે છે (flexicoking માં coke આગળ gasify થાય છે). બંને processes માં સિદ્ધાંત એક જ છે: carbon ને coke તરીકે નકારો જેથી barrel નું liquid balance fuel oil ને બદલે light products બને.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

Coking units high-temperature, batch-sequenced (drum switching, steam-out, water cutting) operations છે જે ફક્ત કડક refinery procedures હેઠળ ચાલે છે. Coke quality તેનું market નક્કી કરે છે: sour residue માંથી high-sulfur, high-metal coke ફક્ત fuel grade હોય છે.

h.en: 3.1(c)(ii–iii) Catalytic cracking and fluidised-bed catalytic cracking (FCC) — construction and working
h.gu: 3.1(c)(ii–iii) Catalytic cracking તથા fluidised-bed catalytic cracking (FCC) — construction તથા working

body.en:
Definition / principle

In catalytic cracking an acid catalyst (today a zeolite-containing microsphere powder) breaks gas-oil molecules through carbonium-ion chemistry, giving more branched, higher-octane petrol and valuable propylene/butylene at far lower pressure than thermal cracking. In FCC the catalyst is fluidised: it flows like a liquid between reactor and regenerator.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Riser reactor: preheated vacuum gas oil meets hot regenerated catalyst at the riser base and cracks while rising, in a few seconds of contact (of the order of 500–540 °C, unit-dependent).
  2. Reactor/stripper and cyclones: catalyst is steam-stripped of oil vapour and separated from product vapour in cyclones.
  3. Regenerator: coke deposited on the catalyst is burned off with air (about 650–720 °C); the hot, cleaned catalyst returns to the riser — and that burning coke supplies the heat of cracking.
  4. Fractionator and gas plant: cracked vapour is separated into dry gas, LPG (propylene/butylene rich), FCC petrol, light cycle oil and slurry/decant oil.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Catalyst circulates continuously: riser (cracking, coke laid down) → stripper → regenerator (coke burned, activity restored) → back to the riser.
  2. Because contact is seconds-short and the catalyst selects branched products, FCC gives high-conversion, high-octane petrol plus petrochemical propylene, which thermal cracking cannot match.

Limitations and safety

Feed metals (nickel, vanadium) and nitrogen poison/damage the catalyst, so heavy residue feeds need pretreatment or special designs; regenerator temperature and catalyst circulation are safety-critical controls operated under refinery procedures.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Catalytic cracking માં acid catalyst (આજે zeolite ધરાવતો microsphere powder) carbonium-ion chemistry થી gas-oil molecules તોડે છે, thermal cracking કરતાં ઘણા ઓછા pressure પર વધુ branched, higher-octane petrol તથા મૂલ્યવાન propylene/butylene આપે છે. FCC માં catalyst fluidised હોય છે: તે reactor તથા regenerator વચ્ચે liquid ની જેમ વહે છે.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Riser reactor: preheated vacuum gas oil riser base પર hot regenerated catalyst ને મળે છે અને ચઢતાં ચઢતાં crack થાય છે, થોડીક seconds ના contact માં (આશરે 500–540 °C ક્રમનું, unit-આધારિત).
  2. Reactor/stripper તથા cyclones: catalyst oil vapour થી steam-strip થાય છે અને cyclones માં product vapour થી છૂટો પડે છે.
  3. Regenerator: catalyst પર જમા coke air થી બાળી નંખાય છે (આશરે 650–720 °C); ગરમ, સાફ catalyst riser તરફ પાછો આવે છે — અને તે બળતો coke જ cracking ની heat પૂરી પાડે છે.
  4. Fractionator તથા gas plant: cracked vapour dry gas, LPG (propylene/butylene થી ભરપૂર), FCC petrol, light cycle oil તથા slurry/decant oil માં છૂટું પડે છે.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Catalyst સતત circulate થાય છે: riser (cracking, coke જમા) → stripper → regenerator (coke બળે, activity પાછી) → પાછો riser તરફ.
  2. Contact seconds-જેટલો ટૂંકો હોવાથી અને catalyst branched products પસંદ કરતો હોવાથી, FCC high-conversion, high-octane petrol વત્તા petrochemical propylene આપે છે, જે thermal cracking આપી શકતું નથી.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

Feed metals (nickel, vanadium) તથા nitrogen catalyst ને poison/નુકસાન કરે છે, તેથી ભારે residue feeds ને pretreatment કે special designs જોઈએ છે; regenerator temperature તથા catalyst circulation safety-critical controls છે જે refinery procedures હેઠળ ચાલે છે.

h.en: 3.1(c)(iv) Hydrocracking — cracking with hydrogen, and the thermal-versus-catalytic comparison
h.gu: 3.1(c)(iv) Hydrocracking — hydrogen સાથે cracking, અને thermal-vs-catalytic comparison

body.en:
Definition / principle

Hydrocracking cracks heavy gas oil with hydrogen at high pressure over a dual-function catalyst (metal hydrogenation sites plus acid cracking sites), so the products are saturated, sulfur/nitrogen-free and in the kerosene/diesel/petrol ranges chosen by the catalyst and severity.

Detailed theory and conditions

Because hydrogen is present, hydrocracking does three jobs at once: it cracks large molecules, saturates the fragments (little olefin, no coke-forming tendency in the products) and removes sulfur, nitrogen and oxygen as H2S, NH3 and water (the hydrotreating chemistry of card 3.3). It therefore converts vacuum gas oil — and, in residue designs, heavier feeds — into premium middle distillates with excellent cetane and smoke-point quality, at the cost of high-pressure equipment and large hydrogen consumption. Unconverted oil from a once-through unit is itself an excellent lube or FCC feed.

Comparison

PointThermal crackingCatalytic cracking (incl. FCC/hydrocracking)
AgentHeat aloneHeat + catalyst (FCC: no H2; hydrocracking: high-pressure H2)
Typical severityHigh temperature, pressure varies; coke rejected as productFCC ~500–540 °C near-low pressure; hydrocracking moderate temperature, high pressure
Petrol qualityMore olefinic, lower octane, less stableMore branched/aromatic (FCC) or saturated (hydrocracked): higher, cleaner quality
Main strengthSimple; destroys residue to coke (coking)Selectivity to wanted products; FCC propylene, hydrocracker diesel/kerosene

Qualification

The comparison is about tendency, not merit in isolation: a refinery chooses among them by feed heaviness, wanted slate (petrol vs diesel vs propylene), hydrogen availability and capital — many refineries run an FCC and a hydrocracker together on different feeds.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Hydrocracking dual-function catalyst (metal hydrogenation sites વત્તા acid cracking sites) પર high pressure hydrogen સાથે heavy gas oil ને crack કરે છે, જેથી products saturated, sulfur/nitrogen-free અને catalyst તથા severity થી પસંદ કરેલા kerosene/diesel/petrol ranges માં હોય છે.

વિગતવાર Theory તથા Conditions

Hydrogen હાજર હોવાથી, hydrocracking એક સાથે ત્રણ કામ કરે છે: તે મોટા molecules crack કરે છે, fragments ને saturate કરે છે (ઓછું olefin, products માં coke-forming tendency નહીં) અને sulfur, nitrogen તથા oxygen ને H2S, NH3 તથા water તરીકે દૂર કરે છે (card 3.3 ની hydrotreating chemistry). તેથી તે vacuum gas oil — અને, residue designs માં, ભારે feeds — ને ઉત્તમ cetane તથા smoke-point quality વાળા premium middle distillates માં ફેરવે છે, high-pressure equipment તથા મોટા hydrogen વપરાશના ખર્ચે. Once-through unit નું unconverted oil પોતે ઉત્તમ lube કે FCC feed છે.

Comparison

મુદ્દોThermal crackingCatalytic cracking (FCC/hydrocracking સહિત)
Agentફક્ત heatHeat + catalyst (FCC: H2 નહીં; hydrocracking: high-pressure H2)
Typical severityHigh temperature, pressure બદલાય; coke product તરીકે નકારાયFCC ~500–540 °C લગભગ-low pressure; hydrocracking moderate temperature, high pressure
Petrol qualityવધુ olefinic, ઓછું octane, ઓછી stableવધુ branched/aromatic (FCC) કે saturated (hydrocracked): વધુ, સ્વચ્છ quality
મુખ્ય તાકાતસરળ; residue ને coke માં નાશ કરે છે (coking)ઇચ્છિત products માટે selectivity; FCC propylene, hydrocracker diesel/kerosene

મર્યાદા / Qualification

Comparison વલણ વિશે છે, એકલા ગુણ વિશે નહીં: refinery feed heaviness, ઇચ્છિત slate (petrol vs diesel vs propylene), hydrogen ઉપલબ્ધતા તથા મૂડી મુજબ તેમની વચ્ચે પસંદગી કરે છે — ઘણી refineries જુદા feeds પર FCC તથા hydrocracker સાથે ચલાવે છે.

h.en: Derivation: conversion, yield and selectivity from the cracking material balance
h.gu: Derivation: cracking material balance માંથી conversion, yield તથા selectivity

body.en:
Symbols, model and assumptions

Steady cracking unit; fresh feed F; unconverted feed material leaving in products U (same boiling range as feed, by the unit's conversion definition); a chosen product P. All flows in the same mass units. No accumulation.

  1. Write the overall balance.

    F = all products (including P, U, gas and coke)

  2. Define converted feed as what did not come out unconverted.

    Converted = F − U

  3. Express conversion as the fraction of feed converted, in percent.

    Conversion % = (F − U) / F × 100

  4. Express the yield of product P on fresh feed, and its selectivity on converted feed.

    Yield of P % = P / F × 100
    Selectivity to P % = P / (F − U) × 100 = Yield / Conversion × 100

4-mark / 7-mark study depth

4-mark path: balance → converted = F − U → boxed conversion → selectivity ratio. For a full 7-mark format state the conversion definition (cut point) used for U. These are study formats, not guaranteed official question marks. Numerical 3.N1 uses these results.
body.gu:
સંકેતો, Model તથા Assumptions

Steady cracking unit; fresh feed F; products માં નીકળતું unconverted feed material U (feed જેવી જ boiling range, unit ની conversion વ્યાખ્યા મુજબ); પસંદ કરેલ product P. બધા flows સરખા mass units માં. Accumulation નહીં.

  1. Overall balance લખો.

    F = બધા products (P, U, gas તથા coke સહિત)

  2. Converted feed ને એ રીતે વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરો જે unconverted બહાર આવ્યું નથી.

    Converted = F − U

  3. Conversion ને feed ના converted fraction તરીકે, percent માં દર્શાવો.

    Conversion % = (F − U) / F × 100

  4. Product P નો yield fresh feed પર, અને તેની selectivity converted feed પર દર્શાવો.

    Yield of P % = P / F × 100
    Selectivity to P % = P / (F − U) × 100 = Yield / Conversion × 100

4-mark / 7-mark Study Depth

4-mark path: balance → converted = F − U → boxed conversion → selectivity ratio. Full 7-mark format માટે U માટે વપરાયેલી conversion વ્યાખ્યા (cut point) જણાવો. આ study formats છે; official marks ની ખાતરી નથી. Numerical 3.N1 આ results વાપરે છે.

h.en: 3.2(a) Purpose of reforming — raising petrol octane from straight-run naphtha
h.gu: 3.2(a) Reforming નો હેતુ — straight-run naphtha માંથી petrol octane વધારવો

body.en:
Definition / principle

Catalytic reforming rearranges low-octane straight-run naphtha molecules — mainly straight-chain paraffins and naphthenes — into branched paraffins and aromatics of high octane number, over a platinum catalyst with hydrogen present.

Detailed theory and conditions

Straight-run naphtha from the ADU contains mostly normal paraffins and naphthenes and has an octane number far below petrol specification. Reforming changes the molecules without much changing their size: naphthenes are dehydrogenated to aromatics (the fastest, most valuable reaction, releasing hydrogen), normal paraffins are isomerised to branched paraffins and dehydrocyclised to aromatics, and some hydrocracking to LPG is unavoidable at severity. The liquid product, reformate, is the main high-octane petrol blendstock of a hydro-skimming/conversion refinery and also the refinery's source of aromatics (BTX, Unit V); the net hydrogen produced feeds the hydrotreaters and hydrocracker.

Key points and data

  • Feed: hydrotreated naphtha (sulfur must be removed first — platinum is poisoned by sulfur).
  • Products: high-octane reformate, hydrogen, LPG and fuel gas.
  • Severity: measured by reformate octane; higher severity gives more octane but less liquid yield and more gas.

Qualification

Reforming improves octane, it does not create volume: reformate liquid yield falls as severity rises, and modern petrol specifications limit total aromatics/benzene, so reformate is blended, not used alone.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Catalytic reforming low-octane straight-run naphtha molecules — મુખ્યત્વે straight-chain paraffins તથા naphthenes — ને hydrogen ની હાજરીમાં platinum catalyst પર high octane number વાળા branched paraffins તથા aromatics માં rearrange કરે છે.

વિગતવાર Theory તથા Conditions

ADU ના straight-run naphtha માં મોટેભાગે normal paraffins તથા naphthenes હોય છે અને તેનો octane number petrol specification થી ઘણો નીચે હોય છે. Reforming molecules નું કદ ખાસ બદલ્યા વગર તેમને બદલે છે: naphthenes dehydrogenate થઈ aromatics બને છે (સૌથી ઝડપી, સૌથી મૂલ્યવાન reaction, hydrogen છૂટે છે), normal paraffins isomerise થઈ branched paraffins બને છે અને dehydrocyclise થઈ aromatics બને છે, અને severity પર થોડું LPG માં hydrocracking અનિવાર્ય છે. Liquid product, reformate, એ hydro-skimming/conversion refinery નો મુખ્ય high-octane petrol blendstock છે અને refinery નો aromatics (BTX, Unit V) નો સ્રોત પણ છે; ઉત્પન્ન થતો net hydrogen hydrotreaters તથા hydrocracker ને મળે છે.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Feed: hydrotreated naphtha (sulfur પહેલાં દૂર થવું જોઈએ — platinum sulfur થી poison થાય છે).
  • Products: high-octane reformate, hydrogen, LPG તથા fuel gas.
  • Severity: reformate octane થી મપાય છે; વધુ severity વધુ octane પણ ઓછું liquid yield અને વધુ gas આપે છે.

મર્યાદા / Qualification

Reforming octane સુધારે છે, volume બનાવતું નથી: severity વધતાં reformate liquid yield ઘટે છે, અને આધુનિક petrol specifications કુલ aromatics/benzene ને મર્યાદિત કરે છે, તેથી reformate blend થાય છે, એકલું વપરાતું નથી.

h.en: 3.2(b) Platforming — construction and working of the catalytic reformer
h.gu: 3.2(b) Platforming — catalytic reformer નું construction તથા working

body.en:
Definition / principle

Platforming (UOP process, named for its platinum catalyst) is the fixed-bed catalytic reforming process: naphtha and hydrogen pass through several catalyst reactors in series with reheating between them.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Naphtha hydrotreater (upstream): removes sulfur, nitrogen and metals that would poison the platinum catalyst.
  2. Heater–reactor train (typically 3–4 reactors): each reactor holds platinum (with rhenium/tin promoters in modern catalysts) on alumina; heaters between reactors restore temperature.
  3. Separator and stabiliser: hydrogen-rich gas is separated and largely recycled; liquid reformate is stabilised (light ends removed) to petrol vapour-pressure specification.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. The main reforming reactions absorb heat (dehydrogenation is strongly endothermic), so the charge cools across each reactor and must be reheated — hence the alternating heater–reactor layout.
  2. Hydrogen is recycled with the feed to suppress coke formation on the catalyst, even though the process is a net hydrogen producer.
  3. In semi-regenerative units the train is shut down periodically to burn off catalyst coke; continuous-regeneration (CCR) designs move catalyst slowly through a regenerator so operation never stops.

Limitations and safety

Platinum catalyst is expensive and poison-sensitive, and the unit handles hydrogen at high temperature: feed purity, hydrogen circulation and heater control are critical, under refinery procedures only.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Platforming (UOP process, તેના platinum catalyst પરથી નામ) એ fixed-bed catalytic reforming process છે: naphtha તથા hydrogen વચ્ચે reheating સાથે શ્રેણીમાં અનેક catalyst reactors માંથી પસાર થાય છે.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Naphtha hydrotreater (upstream): platinum catalyst ને poison કરનારા sulfur, nitrogen તથા metals દૂર કરે છે.
  2. Heater–reactor train (સામાન્ય રીતે 3–4 reactors): દરેક reactor માં alumina પર platinum (આધુનિક catalysts માં rhenium/tin promoters સાથે) હોય છે; reactors વચ્ચેના heaters temperature પાછું આપે છે.
  3. Separator તથા stabiliser: hydrogen-rich gas છૂટું પડી મોટેભાગે recycle થાય છે; liquid reformate petrol vapour-pressure specification માટે stabilise થાય છે (light ends દૂર).

Working — sequence and reason

  1. મુખ્ય reforming reactions heat શોષે છે (dehydrogenation તીવ્ર endothermic છે), તેથી charge દરેક reactor માં ઠંડું પડે છે અને ફરી ગરમ કરવું પડે છે — તેથી જ વૈકલ્પિક heater–reactor layout.
  2. Hydrogen feed સાથે recycle થાય છે જેથી catalyst પર coke formation દબાય, જોકે process net hydrogen producer છે.
  3. Semi-regenerative units માં train સમયાંતરે બંધ કરી catalyst coke બાળવામાં આવે છે; continuous-regeneration (CCR) designs catalyst ને ધીમે ધીમે regenerator માંથી ખસેડે છે જેથી operation કદી અટકતું નથી.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

Platinum catalyst મોંઘું તથા poison-sensitive છે, અને unit ઊંચા temperature પર hydrogen handle કરે છે: feed purity, hydrogen circulation તથા heater control critical છે, ફક્ત refinery procedures હેઠળ.

h.en: 3.3 Hydrotreating — construction, working and uses of hydrogen treating
h.gu: 3.3 Hydrotreating — hydrogen treating નું construction, working તથા ઉપયોગો

body.en:
Definition / principle

Hydrotreating reacts a petroleum fraction with hydrogen over a solid catalyst (commonly cobalt/nickel–molybdenum on alumina) at moderate temperature and elevated pressure, to remove sulfur, nitrogen and oxygen, saturate olefins/aromatics partly, and remove metals — without much cracking of the molecules.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Feed heater and hydrogen mixing: feed is heated and mixed with fresh plus recycled hydrogen.
  2. Fixed-bed reactor(s): one or more catalyst beds with cold hydrogen quench between beds to control the temperature rise (the reactions release heat).
  3. Separation train: high- and low-pressure separators recover hydrogen for recycle; sour gas (H2S) goes to amine treating and sulfur recovery; treated liquid is stripped of light ends.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. On the catalyst, sulfur compounds become H2S, nitrogen compounds NH3, oxygen compounds water, and olefins are saturated — the carbon skeleton is largely preserved (Numerical 3.N2 works a sulfur balance).
  2. Hydrogen is both reactant and protector: it keeps the catalyst surface clean and supplies what the removal reactions consume.

Key points and data

  • Uses: naphtha pretreat for the reformer, kerosene/diesel desulfurisation to specification, lube and wax finishing, FCC/hydrocracker feed pretreatment.
  • Severity scale: mild hydrofinishing (colour/stability) to deep hydrodesulfurisation (ultra-low-sulfur diesel).

Qualification

Hydrotreating cleans molecules; it barely changes boiling range. A fraction that is the wrong size for its product must still be cracked or reformed — treating and conversion are different tools, and Unit IV develops the treating side further.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Hydrotreating petroleum fraction ને ઘન catalyst (સામાન્ય રીતે alumina પર cobalt/nickel–molybdenum) પર moderate temperature તથા elevated pressure પર hydrogen સાથે react કરે છે, જેથી sulfur, nitrogen તથા oxygen દૂર થાય, olefins/aromatics આંશિક saturate થાય, અને metals દૂર થાય — molecules નું ખાસ cracking કર્યા વગર.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Feed heater તથા hydrogen mixing: feed ગરમ થઈ fresh વત્તા recycled hydrogen સાથે ભળે છે.
  2. Fixed-bed reactor(s): એક કે વધુ catalyst beds, beds વચ્ચે temperature rise નિયંત્રિત કરવા cold hydrogen quench સાથે (reactions heat છોડે છે).
  3. Separation train: high- તથા low-pressure separators hydrogen recycle માટે recover કરે છે; sour gas (H2S) amine treating તથા sulfur recovery તરફ જાય છે; treated liquid light ends થી strip થાય છે.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Catalyst પર, sulfur compounds H2S બને છે, nitrogen compounds NH3, oxygen compounds water, અને olefins saturate થાય છે — carbon skeleton મોટેભાગે જળવાય છે (Numerical 3.N2 sulfur balance ગણે છે).
  2. Hydrogen reactant તથા protector બંને છે: તે catalyst surface સ્વચ્છ રાખે છે અને removal reactions ને જોઈતું પૂરું પાડે છે.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • ઉપયોગો: reformer માટે naphtha pretreat, specification માટે kerosene/diesel desulfurisation, lube તથા wax finishing, FCC/hydrocracker feed pretreatment.
  • Severity scale: mild hydrofinishing (colour/stability) થી deep hydrodesulfurisation (ultra-low-sulfur diesel) સુધી.

મર્યાદા / Qualification

Hydrotreating molecules ને સ્વચ્છ કરે છે; boiling range ભાગ્યે જ બદલે છે. જે fraction તેના product માટે ખોટા કદનું છે તેને હજુ crack કે reform કરવું જ પડે છે — treating તથા conversion જુદા સાધનો છે, અને Unit IV treating બાજુને આગળ વિકસાવે છે.

h.en: Practical.1/Activity: Prepare a detailed chart of a modern refinery's conversion section (guided)
h.gu: Practical.1/Activity: Modern refinery ના conversion section નો detailed chart બનાવો (guided)

body.en:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: to extend the Unit 1 refinery chart by adding the Unit 3 conversion units in correct flow positions. Materials: the Unit 1 chart, this unit's diagrams and product data.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Place the FCC and/or hydrocracker on the vacuum-gas-oil line, the coker on vacuum residue, and the reformer on the naphtha line with its hydrotreater before it.
  2. Draw hydrogen from the reformer to the hydrotreaters/hydrocracker and mark coke out of the coker/FCC regenerator.
  3. Annotate each unit with feed, main product and one by-product, and present one complete heavy-molecule path: residue → coker/FCC → petrol/LPG.

Precautions

Arrows must respect severity order: pretreat before reforming/FCC where the catalyst demands it. No plant visit or plant operating data is claimed; plant study, if arranged by the institute, is recorded separately with date and guide.

Observations and result

Journal record: units added ___, one heavy-molecule path explained ___, hydrogen source and users identified ___. Chart activity only.
body.gu:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: Unit 1 ના refinery chart ને Unit 3 ના conversion units સાચી flow positions માં ઉમેરી વિસ્તારવો. Materials: Unit 1 chart, આ unit ના diagrams તથા product data.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. FCC અને/અથવા hydrocracker ને vacuum-gas-oil line પર, coker ને vacuum residue પર, અને reformer ને તેના hydrotreater સાથે પહેલાં naphtha line પર મૂકો.
  2. Reformer માંથી hydrogen hydrotreaters/hydrocracker તરફ દોરો અને coker/FCC regenerator માંથી coke mark કરો.
  3. દરેક unit પર feed, main product તથા એક by-product નોંધો, અને એક સંપૂર્ણ heavy-molecule path રજૂ કરો: residue → coker/FCC → petrol/LPG.

Precautions

h.en: Practice 1. Explain the purpose of cracking and discuss the effects of temperature and pressure on the products obtained.
h.gu: Practice 1. Cracking નો હેતુ સમજાવો અને મળતા products પર temperature તથા pressure ની અસરો ચર્ચો.

body.en:
Definition

Cracking breaks heavy molecules into petrol/LPG/diesel-range products to match market demand.

Explanation and application

  • Temperature raises rate and conversion, but excess severity overcracks liquids to gas and coke; residence time acts with temperature as severity.
  • High pressure opposes the volume increase of cracking yet promotes saturation/condensation and coke; low pressure/steam favour lighter olefinic products.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Cracking ભારે molecules ને market demand મુજબ petrol/LPG/diesel-range products માં તોડે છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Temperature rate તથા conversion વધારે છે, પણ વધુ severity liquids ને gas તથા coke માં overcrack કરે છે; residence time temperature સાથે severity તરીકે કામ કરે છે.
  • ઊંચું pressure cracking ના volume વધારાનો વિરોધ કરે છે છતાં saturation/condensation તથા coke ને પ્રોત્સાહન આપે છે; નીચું pressure/steam હલકા olefinic products ને પ્રાધાન્ય આપે છે.

h.en: Practice 2. Describe visbreaking with a neat flow diagram and state its limitation.
h.gu: Practice 2. સુઘડ flow diagram સાથે visbreaking વર્ણવો અને તેની મર્યાદા જણાવો.

body.en:
Definition

Visbreaking is mild thermal cracking of residue to break viscosity, not to maximise petrol.

Explanation and application

  • Heater (or heater plus soaker) → flash/fractionator → gas, naphtha, gas oil, visbroken residue (flow as in the card diagram pattern).
  • Limitation: severity is stopped early or asphaltenes precipitate and the fuel becomes unstable.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Visbreaking residue નું હળવું thermal cracking છે જેથી viscosity તૂટે, petrol મહત્તમ કરવા માટે નહીં.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Heater (કે heater વત્તા soaker) → flash/fractionator → gas, naphtha, gas oil, visbroken residue (card diagram pattern મુજબ flow).
  • મર્યાદા: severity વહેલી અટકાવાય છે નહીં તો asphaltenes precipitate થાય અને fuel unstable બને છે.

h.en: Practice 3. Explain delayed coking: heater, coke drums and fractionator, and how fluid coking differs in working.
h.gu: Practice 3. Delayed coking સમજાવો: heater, coke drums તથા fractionator, અને fluid coking working માં કેવી રીતે જુદું પડે છે.

body.en:
Definition

Coking rejects the heaviest carbon as solid coke so liquids become light products.

Explanation and application

  • Rapid heater → twin coke drums alternately filling/cutting → fractionator for gas, naphtha and coker gas oils.
  • Fluid coking instead circulates hot coke particles continuously and burns part of the coke for heat.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Coking સૌથી ભારે carbon ને ઘન coke તરીકે નકારે છે જેથી liquids હલકા products બને.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Rapid heater → વૈકલ્પિક રીતે ભરાતા/કપાતા twin coke drums → gas, naphtha તથા coker gas oils માટે fractionator.
  • Fluid coking તેના બદલે hot coke particles ને સતત circulate કરે છે અને heat માટે coke નો ભાગ બાળે છે.

h.en: Practice 4. With a diagram, explain the construction and working of an FCC unit, including catalyst circulation and regeneration.
h.gu: Practice 4. Diagram સાથે FCC unit નું construction તથા working સમજાવો, catalyst circulation તથા regeneration સહિત.

body.en:
Definition

FCC cracks gas oil in seconds over a fluidised zeolite catalyst circulating between riser and regenerator.

Explanation and application

  • Riser cracking → stripping/cyclones → regenerator burns coke off and reheats catalyst (diagram ref3_fcc).
  • Products: dry gas, LPG/propylene, high-octane petrol, cycle oils.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

FCC gas oil ને riser તથા regenerator વચ્ચે circulate થતા fluidised zeolite catalyst પર seconds માં crack કરે છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Riser cracking → stripping/cyclones → regenerator coke બાળી catalyst ફરી ગરમ કરે છે (diagram ref3_fcc).
  • Products: dry gas, LPG/propylene, high-octane petrol, cycle oils.

h.en: Practice 5. Compare thermal and catalytic cracking on agent, conditions, product quality and main use.
h.gu: Practice 5. Thermal તથા catalytic cracking ની agent, conditions, product quality તથા main use પર સરખામણી કરો.

body.en:
Definition

Thermal cracking uses heat alone; catalytic cracking directs the same breaking with a catalyst.

Comparison

  • Agent/conditions: heat alone at high severity vs catalyst at milder pressure (hydrocracking adds high-pressure hydrogen).
  • Quality/use: olefinic lower-octane petrol vs branched, cleaner, higher-octane products; coking for residue destruction vs FCC/hydrocracker selectivity.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Thermal cracking ફક્ત heat વાપરે છે; catalytic cracking એ જ breaking ને catalyst થી દિશા આપે છે.

Comparison

  • Agent/conditions: ઊંચી severity પર ફક્ત heat vs હળવા pressure પર catalyst (hydrocracking high-pressure hydrogen ઉમેરે છે).
  • Quality/use: olefinic ઓછા-octane petrol vs branched, સ્વચ્છ, higher-octane products; residue નાશ માટે coking vs FCC/hydrocracker selectivity.

h.en: Practice 6. Explain the purpose of reforming and describe Platforming, stating why heaters are placed between reactors.
h.gu: Practice 6. Reforming નો હેતુ સમજાવો અને Platforming વર્ણવો, reactors વચ્ચે heaters કેમ મૂકાય છે તે જણાવો.

body.en:
Definition

Reforming rearranges straight-run naphtha to high-octane branched/aromatic molecules and net hydrogen.

Explanation and application

  • Hydrotreated naphtha → heater/reactor train (3–4 Pt reactors) → separator/stabiliser (Platforming).
  • Heaters sit between reactors because dehydrogenation is endothermic and the charge cools each pass.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Reforming straight-run naphtha ને high-octane branched/aromatic molecules તથા net hydrogen માં rearrange કરે છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Hydrotreated naphtha → heater/reactor train (3–4 Pt reactors) → separator/stabiliser (Platforming).
  • Reactors વચ્ચે heaters હોય છે કારણ કે dehydrogenation endothermic છે અને charge દરેક pass માં ઠંડું પડે છે.

h.en: Practice 7. Describe a hydrotreater: construction, working, products, and any three uses in a refinery.
h.gu: Practice 7. Hydrotreater વર્ણવો: construction, working, products, અને refinery માં તેના કોઈ ત્રણ ઉપયોગો.

body.en:
Definition

Hydrotreating reacts fractions with hydrogen on Co/Ni-Mo catalyst to remove S, N, O and metals and saturate olefins.

Explanation and application

  • Heater + hydrogen → fixed-bed reactor with quench → separators recycle hydrogen; H2S to sulfur recovery.
  • Uses: reformer-feed pretreat, diesel/kerosene desulfurisation, FCC feed pretreat (any three).
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Hydrotreating fractions ને Co/Ni-Mo catalyst પર hydrogen સાથે react કરી S, N, O તથા metals દૂર કરે છે અને olefins saturate કરે છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Heater + hydrogen → quench સાથે fixed-bed reactor → separators hydrogen recycle કરે છે; H2S sulfur recovery તરફ.
  • ઉપયોગો: reformer-feed pretreat, diesel/kerosene desulfurisation, FCC feed pretreat (કોઈ ત્રણ).

h.en: Practice 8. An FCC feed of 10 000 kg/h gives 3500 kg/h unconverted material and 4500 kg/h petrol. Calculate conversion and petrol selectivity, showing every step.
h.gu: Practice 8. 10 000 kg/h FCC feed 3500 kg/h unconverted material અને 4500 kg/h petrol આપે છે. દરેક step બતાવી conversion તથા petrol selectivity ગણો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

F = 10 000 kg/h, U = 3500 kg/h, P = 4500 kg/h, steady state.

Step-by-step solution

Conversion = (10 000 − 3500)/10 000 × 100 = 65.0 %; selectivity = 4500/6500 × 100 = 69.2 %.

Interpretation and check

Conversion 65.0 %; petrol selectivity 69.2 %. Full balance with LPG is in Numerical 3.N1.
body.gu:
આપેલ તથા ધારણાઓ

F = 10 000 kg/h, U = 3500 kg/h, P = 4500 kg/h, steady state.

Step-by-step solution

Conversion = (10 000 − 3500)/10 000 × 100 = 65.0 %; selectivity = 4500/6500 × 100 = 69.2 %.

અર્થઘટન તથા check

Conversion 65.0 %; petrol selectivity 69.2 %. LPG સાથે સંપૂર્ણ balance Numerical 3.N1 માં છે.

q.en: Numerical 3.N1: An FCC unit receives 10 000 kg/h of vacuum gas oil. Products include 3500 kg/h of unconverted cycle oil/slurry (counted as unconverted feed), 4500 kg/h of petrol, 1200 kg/h of LPG and 800 kg/h of gas plus coke. Calculate conversion, petrol yield and petrol selectivity.
q.gu: Numerical 3.N1: FCC unit ને 10 000 kg/h vacuum gas oil મળે છે. Products માં 3500 kg/h unconverted cycle oil/slurry (unconverted feed ગણતાં), 4500 kg/h petrol, 1200 kg/h LPG અને 800 kg/h gas વત્તા coke છે. Conversion, petrol yield તથા petrol selectivity ગણો.

a.en:
Given

Fresh feed F = 10 000 kg/h. Unconverted material U = 3500 kg/h. Petrol P = 4500 kg/h. LPG = 1200 kg/h; gas + coke = 800 kg/h. Products sum to the feed at steady state.

Find

Find conversion %, petrol yield % on feed, and petrol selectivity % on converted feed.

Formula

Conversion % = (F − U) / F × 100
Yield of P % = P / F × 100
Selectivity to P % = P / (F − U) × 100

Substitution and calculation

Converted feed = 10 000 − 3500 = 6500 kg/h
Conversion = 6500 / 10 000 × 100 = 65.0 %
Petrol yield = 4500 / 10 000 × 100 = 45.0 %
Petrol selectivity = 4500 / 6500 × 100 = 69.23 %

Final answer with units

Conversion = 65.0 %; Petrol yield = 45.0 %
Petrol selectivity = 69.2 % of converted feed

Validity check

Product masses sum to 3500 + 4500 + 1200 + 800 = 10 000 kg/h, closing the balance, and yield (45.0) divided by conversion (65.0) gives 69.2 % selectivity as it must. LPG yield is another 12 % of feed — conversion units must always be judged on all three numbers together, not conversion alone.
a.gu:
આપેલ

Fresh feed F = 10 000 kg/h. Unconverted material U = 3500 kg/h. Petrol P = 4500 kg/h. LPG = 1200 kg/h; gas + coke = 800 kg/h. Steady state પર products નો સરવાળો feed જેટલો થાય છે.

શોધો

Conversion %, feed પર petrol yield %, અને converted feed પર petrol selectivity % શોધો.

સૂત્ર

Conversion % = (F − U) / F × 100
Yield of P % = P / F × 100
Selectivity to P % = P / (F − U) × 100

Substitution તથા Calculation

Converted feed = 10 000 − 3500 = 6500 kg/h
Conversion = 6500 / 10 000 × 100 = 65.0 %
Petrol yield = 4500 / 10 000 × 100 = 45.0 %
Petrol selectivity = 4500 / 6500 × 100 = 69.23 %

Units સાથે અંતિમ જવાબ

Conversion = 65.0 %; Petrol yield = 45.0 %
Petrol selectivity = converted feed ના 69.2 %

Validity Check

Product masses નો સરવાળો 3500 + 4500 + 1200 + 800 = 10 000 kg/h થાય છે, balance close થાય છે, અને yield (45.0) ને conversion (65.0) થી ભાગતાં 69.2 % selectivity મળે છે જે મળવી જ જોઈએ. LPG yield feed ના બીજા 12 % છે — conversion units ને હંમેશા ત્રણેય આંકડા સાથે જજ કરવા જોઈએ, ફક્ત conversion થી નહીં.

q.en: Numerical 3.N2: A hydrotreater processes 1000 kg of diesel containing 1.20 % sulfur by mass and produces diesel with 0.05 % sulfur (oil mass taken as 1000 kg for this balance). Calculate sulfur removed, removal efficiency, and the approximate H2S formed (S + H2 → H2S; atomic masses S = 32, H = 1).
q.gu: Numerical 3.N2: Hydrotreater 1.20 % sulfur (mass મુજબ) ધરાવતા 1000 kg diesel ને process કરી 0.05 % sulfur વાળું diesel આપે છે (આ balance માટે oil mass 1000 kg લો). દૂર થતું sulfur, removal efficiency, અને આશરે બનતું H2S ગણો (S + H2 → H2S; atomic masses S = 32, H = 1).

a.en:
Given

Feed oil = 1000 kg with 1.20 % S; product oil taken as 1000 kg with 0.05 % S (oil loss to gas neglected in this teaching balance). Reaction shown as S + H2 → H2S, so 32 kg of S forms 34 kg of H2S.

Find

Find sulfur in, sulfur out, sulfur removed, removal efficiency %, and approximate H2S formed.

Formula

Sulfur mass = oil mass × (S % / 100)
Removal efficiency % = sulfur removed / sulfur in × 100
H2S formed = sulfur removed × 34 / 32

Substitution and calculation

Sulfur in = 1000 × 0.0120 = 12.00 kg
Sulfur out in oil = 1000 × 0.0005 = 0.50 kg
Sulfur removed = 12.00 − 0.50 = 11.50 kg
Efficiency = 11.50 / 12.00 × 100 = 95.83 %
H2S formed = 11.50 × 34 / 32 = 12.22 kg

Final answer with units

Sulfur removed = 11.5 kg; efficiency = 95.8 %
Approximate H2S formed = 12.2 kg (to amine/sulfur recovery)

Validity check

0.05 % of 1000 kg is 0.50 kg, and 11.50 + 0.50 = 12.00 kg closes the sulfur balance. Real hydrotreating also consumes hydrogen for olefin/aromatic saturation, so total hydrogen use exceeds this sulfur-only figure; the H2S number is the sulfur-route approximation stated in the question.
a.gu:
આપેલ

Feed oil = 1000 kg, 1.20 % S સાથે; product oil 1000 kg લીધું, 0.05 % S સાથે (આ teaching balance માં oil loss to gas અવગણ્યો). Reaction S + H2 → H2S તરીકે બતાવ્યું, તેથી 32 kg S માંથી 34 kg H2S બને છે.

શોધો

આવતું sulfur, બહાર જતું sulfur, દૂર થતું sulfur, removal efficiency %, અને આશરે બનતું H2S શોધો.

સૂત્ર

Sulfur mass = oil mass × (S % / 100)
Removal efficiency % = દૂર થતું sulfur / આવતું sulfur × 100
H2S formed = દૂર થતું sulfur × 34 / 32

Substitution તથા Calculation

Sulfur in = 1000 × 0.0120 = 12.00 kg
Sulfur out in oil = 1000 × 0.0005 = 0.50 kg
Sulfur removed = 12.00 − 0.50 = 11.50 kg
Efficiency = 11.50 / 12.00 × 100 = 95.83 %
H2S formed = 11.50 × 34 / 32 = 12.22 kg

Units સાથે અંતિમ જવાબ

Sulfur removed = 11.5 kg; efficiency = 95.8 %
આશરે H2S formed = 12.2 kg (amine/sulfur recovery તરફ)

Validity Check

1000 kg ના 0.05 % એટલે 0.50 kg, અને 11.50 + 0.50 = 12.00 kg sulfur balance close કરે છે. વાસ્તવિક hydrotreating olefin/aromatic saturation માટે પણ hydrogen વાપરે છે, તેથી કુલ hydrogen વપરાશ આ ફક્ત-sulfur આંકડા કરતાં વધે છે; H2S નો આંકડો પ્રશ્નમાં જણાવેલ sulfur-route approximation છે.

q.en: Numerical 3.N3: A reformer is charged 1000 kg/h of hydrotreated naphtha. It produces 840 kg/h of reformate, 90 kg/h of LPG, 50 kg/h of fuel gas and 20 kg/h of net hydrogen. Calculate the reformate liquid yield and verify the balance; state what happens to liquid yield if severity (octane) is raised.
q.gu: Numerical 3.N3: Reformer ને 1000 kg/h hydrotreated naphtha મળે છે. તે 840 kg/h reformate, 90 kg/h LPG, 50 kg/h fuel gas અને 20 kg/h net hydrogen આપે છે. Reformate liquid yield ગણો અને balance verify કરો; severity (octane) વધારતાં liquid yield ને શું થાય તે જણાવો.

a.en:
Given

Naphtha feed = 1000 kg/h. Products: reformate 840, LPG 90, fuel gas 50, net hydrogen 20, all kg/h. Steady state.

Find

Find reformate yield % on feed and check the overall balance.

Formula

Reformate yield % = reformate / feed × 100
Feed = reformate + LPG + fuel gas + net hydrogen

Substitution and calculation

Products total = 840 + 90 + 50 + 20 = 1000 kg/h
Reformate yield = 840 / 1000 × 100 = 84.0 %

Final answer with units

Reformate yield = 84.0 % on feed; balance closes at 1000 kg/h

Validity check

The hydrogen appears as a product (20 kg/h) because reforming is a net hydrogen producer — the opposite sign to a hydrotreater balance. Raising severity for higher octane cracks more naphtha to LPG/gas, so liquid reformate yield falls below this 84 % even though petrol quality rises: the yield–octane trade-off of card 3.2(a).
a.gu:
આપેલ

Naphtha feed = 1000 kg/h. Products: reformate 840, LPG 90, fuel gas 50, net hydrogen 20, બધા kg/h માં. Steady state.

શોધો

Feed પર reformate yield % શોધો અને overall balance check કરો.

સૂત્ર

Reformate yield % = reformate / feed × 100
Feed = reformate + LPG + fuel gas + net hydrogen

Substitution તથા Calculation

Products total = 840 + 90 + 50 + 20 = 1000 kg/h
Reformate yield = 840 / 1000 × 100 = 84.0 %

Units સાથે અંતિમ જવાબ

Reformate yield = feed પર 84.0 %; balance 1000 kg/h પર close થાય છે

Validity Check

Hydrogen product તરીકે દેખાય છે (20 kg/h) કારણ કે reforming net hydrogen producer છે — hydrotreater balance થી વિરુદ્ધ sign. વધુ octane માટે severity વધારતાં વધુ naphtha LPG/gas માં crack થાય છે, તેથી petrol quality વધવા છતાં liquid reformate yield આ 84 % થી નીચે જાય છે: card 3.2(a) નો yield–octane trade-off.

terms.en: U is unconverted feed-range material in the products; the cut point defining U must be stated.
terms.gu: U એ products માંનું unconverted feed-range material છે; U ને વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરતો cut point જણાવવો જોઈએ.

items.f: Yield of P % = P/F × 100;  Selectivity % = P/(F − U) × 100

terms.en: Yield judges the plant, selectivity judges the chemistry; selectivity = yield/conversion.
terms.gu: Yield plant ને જજ કરે છે, selectivity chemistry ને; selectivity = yield/conversion.

items.f: S removed = oil × (Sin − Sout) %;  efficiency = removed/in × 100

terms.en: Sulfur leaves mainly as H2S to amine treating and sulfur recovery; see Numerical 3.N2.
terms.gu: Sulfur મુખ્યત્વે H2S તરીકે amine treating તથા sulfur recovery તરફ જાય છે; Numerical 3.N2 જુઓ.

items.f: Feed = reformate + LPG + gas + net hydrogen produced

terms.en: Reforming produces hydrogen; hydrotreating and hydrocracking consume it — the refinery hydrogen balance links Units 3 and 4.
terms.gu: Reforming hydrogen ઉત્પન્ન કરે છે; hydrotreating તથા hydrocracking તેને વાપરે છે — refinery hydrogen balance Units 3 તથા 4 ને જોડે છે.

q.en: What is the purpose of cracking?
q.gu: Cracking નો હેતુ શું છે?

a.en: To break surplus heavy molecules into petrol, LPG and diesel-range products that the market wants, rejecting some gas and coke.
a.gu: વધારાના ભારે molecules ને market ને જોઈતા petrol, LPG તથા diesel-range products માં તોડવા, થોડો gas તથા coke નકારીને.

q.en: What happens to cracking products if temperature is raised too far?
q.gu: Temperature વધુ પડતું વધારતાં cracking products ને શું થાય છે?

a.en: Conversion rises but the wanted liquids are themselves cracked to dry gas and coke, so liquid yield and stability fall.
a.gu: Conversion વધે છે પણ ઇચ્છિત liquids પોતે dry gas તથા coke માં crack થાય છે, તેથી liquid yield તથા stability ઘટે છે.

q.en: How does pressure influence cracking?
q.gu: Pressure cracking ને કેવી રીતે અસર કરે છે?

a.en: High pressure opposes the volume-increasing cracking step but promotes condensation, saturation and coke-forming secondary reactions, giving denser, more saturated liquids.
a.gu: ઊંચું pressure volume-વધારતા cracking step નો વિરોધ કરે છે પણ condensation, saturation તથા coke-forming secondary reactions ને પ્રોત્સાહન આપે છે, વધુ ઘટ્ટ, વધુ saturated liquids આપે છે.

q.en: What is visbreaking meant to achieve?
q.gu: Visbreaking શું સિદ્ધ કરવા માટે છે?

a.en: A mild residue cracking that lowers viscosity so the residue can be sold as fuel oil with much less cutter oil, stopped before the product becomes unstable.
a.gu: હળવું residue cracking જે viscosity ઘટાડે છે જેથી residue ઘણા ઓછા cutter oil સાથે fuel oil તરીકે વેચી શકાય, product unstable બને તે પહેલાં અટકાવેલું.

q.en: Why is coking called delayed?
q.gu: Coking ને delayed કેમ કહે છે?

a.en: The feed is heated quickly in the furnace and coke formation is delayed until it soaks in the coke drum, keeping the heater tubes from coking.
a.gu: Feed furnace માં ઝડપથી ગરમ થાય છે અને coke formation તે coke drum માં soak થાય ત્યાં સુધી delayed રહે છે, heater tubes ને coking થી બચાવે છે.

q.en: What circulates in an FCC unit and why?
q.gu: FCC unit માં શું circulate થાય છે અને કેમ?

a.en: Powder catalyst: it cracks feed in the riser, is stripped, then regenerated by burning off its coke, whose heat drives the cracking as the hot catalyst returns.
a.gu: Powder catalyst: તે riser માં feed crack કરે છે, strip થાય છે, પછી તેનો coke બાળી regenerate થાય છે, જેની heat ગરમ catalyst પાછો ફરતાં cracking ચલાવે છે.

q.en: How does hydrocracking differ from FCC?
q.gu: Hydrocracking FCC થી કેવી રીતે જુદું પડે છે?

a.en: Hydrocracking uses high-pressure hydrogen on a dual-function catalyst, giving saturated, clean diesel/kerosene-range products, while FCC works without hydrogen and gives olefinic petrol and propylene.
a.gu: Hydrocracking dual-function catalyst પર high-pressure hydrogen વાપરે છે, saturated, સ્વચ્છ diesel/kerosene-range products આપે છે, જ્યારે FCC hydrogen વગર કામ કરે છે અને olefinic petrol તથા propylene આપે છે.

q.en: State two differences between thermal and catalytic cracking.
q.gu: Thermal તથા catalytic cracking વચ્ચે બે તફાવત જણાવો.

a.en: Thermal uses heat alone and gives more olefinic, lower-octane, less stable petrol; catalytic uses a catalyst to give more branched, higher-octane products at milder pressure, with selectivity thermal cracking cannot provide.
a.gu: Thermal ફક્ત heat વાપરે છે અને વધુ olefinic, ઓછા-octane, ઓછી stable petrol આપે છે; catalytic catalyst વાપરી હળવા pressure પર વધુ branched, higher-octane products આપે છે, thermal cracking આપી ન શકે તેવી selectivity સાથે.

q.en: Why must reformer feed be hydrotreated first?
q.gu: Reformer feed પહેલાં hydrotreat કેમ કરવું પડે છે?

a.en: Sulfur, nitrogen and metals in untreated naphtha poison the platinum reforming catalyst, so they are removed in the naphtha hydrotreater upstream.
a.gu: અનુપચારિત naphtha માંના sulfur, nitrogen તથા metals platinum reforming catalyst ને poison કરે છે, તેથી તેઓ ઉપરના naphtha hydrotreater માં દૂર થાય છે.

q.en: Why does a Platforming unit have heaters between reactors?
q.gu: Platforming unit માં reactors વચ્ચે heaters કેમ હોય છે?

a.en: The main reforming reactions are endothermic, so the charge cools through each reactor and must be reheated to keep the reaction rate and octane up.
a.gu: મુખ્ય reforming reactions endothermic છે, તેથી charge દરેક reactor માં ઠંડું પડે છે અને reaction rate તથા octane જાળવવા ફરી ગરમ કરવું પડે છે.

q.en: What does hydrotreating remove and what does it not do?
q.gu: Hydrotreating શું દૂર કરે છે અને શું કરતું નથી?

a.en: It removes sulfur, nitrogen, oxygen and metals and saturates olefins, but it barely changes boiling range — wrong-sized molecules still need cracking or reforming.
a.gu: તે sulfur, nitrogen, oxygen તથા metals દૂર કરે છે અને olefins saturate કરે છે, પણ boiling range ભાગ્યે જ બદલે છે — ખોટા કદના molecules ને હજુ cracking કે reforming જોઈએ છે.

q.en: Define conversion, yield and selectivity in one line each.
q.gu: Conversion, yield તથા selectivity દરેક એક line માં વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરો.

a.en: Conversion is the percent of feed not recovered unconverted; yield is product mass per unit feed; selectivity is product per unit feed actually converted.
a.gu: Conversion એ unconverted પાછું ન મળેલ feed ની ટકાવારી છે; yield એ feed ના એકમ દીઠ product mass છે; selectivity એ ખરેખર convert થયેલા feed ના એકમ દીઠ product છે.

q.en: Practice: Explain the purpose of cracking and discuss the effects of temperature and pressure on the products obtained.
q.gu: Practice: Cracking નો હેતુ સમજાવો અને મળતા products પર temperature તથા pressure ની અસરો ચર્ચો.

q.en: Practice: Describe visbreaking with a neat flow diagram and state its limitation.
q.gu: Practice: સુઘડ flow diagram સાથે visbreaking વર્ણવો અને તેની મર્યાદા જણાવો.

q.en: Practice: Explain delayed coking: heater, coke drums and fractionator, and how fluid coking differs in working.
q.gu: Practice: Delayed coking સમજાવો: heater, coke drums તથા fractionator, અને fluid coking working માં કેવી રીતે જુદું પડે છે.

q.en: Practice: With a diagram, explain the construction and working of an FCC unit, including catalyst circulation and regeneration.
q.gu: Practice: Diagram સાથે FCC unit નું construction તથા working સમજાવો, catalyst circulation તથા regeneration સહિત.

q.en: Practice: Compare thermal and catalytic cracking on agent, conditions, product quality and main use.
q.gu: Practice: Thermal તથા catalytic cracking ની agent, conditions, product quality તથા main use પર સરખામણી કરો.

q.en: Practice: Explain the purpose of reforming and describe Platforming, stating why heaters are placed between reactors.
q.gu: Practice: Reforming નો હેતુ સમજાવો અને Platforming વર્ણવો, reactors વચ્ચે heaters કેમ મૂકાય છે તે જણાવો.

q.en: Practice: Describe a hydrotreater: construction, working, products, and any three uses in a refinery.
q.gu: Practice: Hydrotreater વર્ણવો: construction, working, products, અને refinery માં તેના કોઈ ત્રણ ઉપયોગો.

q.en: Practice: An FCC feed of 10 000 kg/h gives 3500 kg/h unconverted material and 4500 kg/h petrol. Calculate conversion and petrol selectivity, showing every step.
q.gu: Practice: 10 000 kg/h FCC feed 3500 kg/h unconverted material અને 4500 kg/h petrol આપે છે. દરેક step બતાવી conversion તથા petrol selectivity ગણો.

title.en: Prepare a detail chart of modern refinery
title.gu: Modern refinery નો detailed chart બનાવો

body.en:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: to extend the Unit 1 refinery chart by adding the Unit 3 conversion units in correct flow positions. Materials: the Unit 1 chart, this unit's diagrams and product data.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Place the FCC and/or hydrocracker on the vacuum-gas-oil line, the coker on vacuum residue, and the reformer on the naphtha line with its hydrotreater before it.
  2. Draw hydrogen from the reformer to the hydrotreaters/hydrocracker and mark coke out of the coker/FCC regenerator.
  3. Annotate each unit with feed, main product and one by-product, and present one complete heavy-molecule path: residue → coker/FCC → petrol/LPG.

Precautions

Arrows must respect severity order: pretreat before reforming/FCC where the catalyst demands it. No plant visit or plant operating data is claimed; plant study, if arranged by the institute, is recorded separately with date and guide.

Observations and result

Journal record: units added ___, one heavy-molecule path explained ___, hydrogen source and users identified ___. Chart activity only.
body.gu:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: Unit 1 ના refinery chart ને Unit 3 ના conversion units સાચી flow positions માં ઉમેરી વિસ્તારવો. Materials: Unit 1 chart, આ unit ના diagrams તથા product data.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. FCC અને/અથવા hydrocracker ને vacuum-gas-oil line પર, coker ને vacuum residue પર, અને reformer ને તેના hydrotreater સાથે પહેલાં naphtha line પર મૂકો.
  2. Reformer માંથી hydrogen hydrotreaters/hydrocracker તરફ દોરો અને coker/FCC regenerator માંથી coke mark કરો.
  3. દરેક unit પર feed, main product તથા એક by-product નોંધો, અને એક સંપૂર્ણ heavy-molecule path રજૂ કરો: residue → coker/FCC → petrol/LPG.

Precautions

Arrows એ severity order જાળવવો જોઈએ: catalyst માંગે ત્યાં reforming/FCC પહેલાં pretreat. કોઈ plant visit કે plant operating data નો દાવો નથી; સંસ્થા દ્વારા ગોઠવાયેલ plant study, જો હોય તો, તારીખ તથા guide સાથે અલગ નોંધાય છે.

Observations and result

Journal record: ઉમેરેલા units ___, સમજાવેલો એક heavy-molecule path ___, ઓળખાયેલ hydrogen source તથા users ___. ફક્ત chart activity.
